# TRANSBOOS — full content

## Overview
TRANSBOOS was founded by brake engineers who were tired of road-caliber parts failing on track. We build one thing, and only one thing, to an uncompromising standard: the ability to slow a fast car down, repeatedly, without drama. From a single workshop to a global distribution network, every TRANSBOOS kit is designed, tested and validated by people who actually race.

## Tagline
Precision Braking. Zero Compromise.

### TB-MB Series Monoblock Calipers (Calipers)
Forged. Rigid. Relentless.

CNC-forged from a single billet of aerospace aluminium, the TB-MB monoblock eliminates flex under extreme clamp loads so pedal feel stays surgical from the first corner to the last.

Highlights:
- 4 / 6 / 8-pot configurations
- Hard-anodised for corrosion resistance
- Bolt-on brackets for 200+ applications
- Staggered piston sizes to cut pad taper

Specifications:
- Material: Forged 6061-T6 aluminium
- Piston options: 4 / 6 / 8
- Finish: Type-III hard anodise
- Weight (6-pot): 2.9 kg

### TB-DR Slotted Floating Discs (Discs)
Cooler rotors. Consistent bite.

Directional slots evacuate gas and debris while the aluminium hat lets the ring float, reducing thermal warping and keeping bite stable through long sessions.

Highlights:
- Slotted & directional friction face
- Aluminium floating bell
- Geomet-coated to resist rust
- Sizes 330–405 mm

Specifications:
- Diameter range: 330–405 mm
- Construction: Floating 2-piece
- Coating: GEOMET
- Vanes: 48 curved internal

### TB-RX Track Brake Pads (Pads)
Fade-free by design.

A sintered track compound with a high initial mu and a wide temperature window, giving a predictable, repeatable pedal from cold to 800 °C.

Highlights:
- Operating window 0–800 °C
- High initial bite
- Low compressibility
- Track-day & sprint focused

Specifications:
- Compound: Sintered track
- Peak μ: 0.52
- Max temp: 800 °C
- Bed-in: Required

### TB-SS Line & Fluid Kits (Lines & Fluid)
A rock-solid pedal.

Stainless braided lines and a 320 °C dry-boiling-point fluid remove the sponge, holding pressure exactly where you put it under repeated heavy braking.

Highlights:
- PTFE-core braided lines
- Dry boiling point 320 °C
- Direct-fit banjo ends
- Track & road kits

Specifications:
- Line: Stainless braided
- Fluid BP (dry): 320 °C
- Fittings: Anodised aluminium
- Kit type: Axle / full car

## Technology
- Forged Monoblock: A single forged billet removes the flex and leak paths of multi-piece calipers, so clamp force goes to the pad — not into the casting.
- Thermal Control: Curved internal vanes pump air through the disc, while floating bells let the ring expand freely and resist warping under heat.
- Track Validation: Every compound and caliper is dyno-mapped then proven in endurance racing before it earns a part number.
- Precision Manufacturing: Five-axis CNC, CMM inspection and batch traceability on every component we ship.
